description: Word captions 9:16 (brand style "brand-word"): Neuborn 5 % H, 1–3 words, word by word on their own start frames, emphasised words alone with a pop, hard shadow, no box, centred at 66 % H. Reads captions.json with word timings (rule W1). Alpha overlay for the whole timeline (overlay track).

parameters.captions: Path of captions.json (default "captions.json"; must be a declared input)
parameters.startFrame: Timeline frame shown by output frame 0 (default 0; chapters of long overlays)
